Feature request (rule-6 decision): one C symbol cannot be bound with two signatures — `extern "libc.so.6" syscall(...)` fixed-arity declarations are needed by Landlock (`create_ruleset`/`add_rule`/`restrict_self` place the pointer at different positions) but the first declaration wins and the rest are silently ignored (`SEM013`), so the only measured workaround is raw `malloc`+`memcpy` `Long` pointers. The proposed minimum is a symbol alias (`extern ... syscall as landlockAddRule(...)`) or overload-by-signature — a new FFI language surface (D-R3-3.5 forbids general Kof variadics), outside the 1.0 core; registered as a DECISION REQUEST in `docs/development/README.md` §3.

Native `Int?` PARAMETER slot (MAGIC box) feeding a primitive-arg std call printed pointer garbage (`absIt(-7)` -> 1650458528) on x86-64; root: the native `valueOf` dispatch mapped the erasure box `Integer.valueOf(int)` (same name as the `String.valueOf` stringify sugar) to `kof_int_to_string`, so the callee's soft-unbox read the string pointer as the integer. Fix landed 06/10 (§612, lane compiler/JVM/native `192.168.15.30:9092`): `NativeOpHelpers.wrapperValueOfBoxFn` emits `kof_box_*` for a wrapper-owned `valueOf` on a raw primitive in both native emitters; proof `NullableGuardFrameE2ETest` 14/14 + x86-64/riscv64/aarch64(qemu) `5/3/0` + 143-run non-regression + golden 116/116. Issue stays OPEN (closure maintainer-gated); row stays until closed.
